items.text: Kwathi lapho umduli usuwakhiwe, sengifakile lezivalo, abalindi bamasango labahlabeleli lamaLevi sebekhethiwe,
ngabeka umfowethu uHanani loHananiya induna yenqaba ukuba babe ngabaphathi beJerusalema, ngoba uHananiya wayengumuntu othembekileyo lowesaba uNkulunkulu ukwedlula abanengi.

Ngathi kibo: Lingawavuli amasango eJerusalema lize likhwele ilanga, liwavale liwanxibe ilanga lisephezulu. Khethani abalindi ebantwini abahlala eJerusalema, abanye libabeke endaweni zokulinda, abanye babe phambi kwezabo izindlu.
Umuzi wawubanzi, umkhulu, kodwa abantu ababekiwo babelutshwana, lezindlu zazingakakhiwa.
Ezra 2:1–70
UNkulunkulu wasefaka engqondweni yami ukuba ngibuthanise izikhulu lezinduna labantu ukuba babhalwe ngezizukulwana. Ngafumana ugwalo lwezizukulwana zalabo abafika kuqala. Kwakubhalwe kulo ukuthi:
Nampa abantu belizwe ababuya ekuthunjweni kulabo ababethunjiwe nguNebukadineza inkosi yaseBabiloni, yabasa eBabiloni; babuyela eJerusalema lakoJuda, kwaba yilowo lalowo emzini wakibo.
Bafika loZerubabeli loJeshuwa loNehemiya loAzariya loRahamiya loNahamani loMoridekayi loBilishani loMisiperethi loBigivayi loNehuma loBahana.
Nantu uluhlu lwabantu bakoIsrayeli.
AbakoParoshi babezinkulungwane ezimbili lekhulu lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lambili;
abakoShefathiya babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lambili;
abakoAra babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amahlanu lambili;
abakoPahathi‐Mowabi, ngitsho abendlu kaJeshuwa loJowabi, babezinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu aficaminwembili letshumi lesificaminwembili;
abakoElamu babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane;
abakoZathu babengamakhulu aficaminwembili lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
abakoZakayi babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi ayisithupha;
abakoBinuwi babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amane lesificaminwembili;
abakoBebayi babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lesificaminwembili;
abakoAzigadi babezinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili lambili;
abakoAdonikamu babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi ayisithupha lesikhombisa;
abakoBigivayi babezinkulungwane ezimbili lamatshumi ayisithupha lesikhombisa;
abakoAdini babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amahlanu lanhlanu;
abakoAteri, ngitsho bakoHezekiya, babengamatshumi aficamunwemunye lesificaminwembili;
abakoHashuma babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili lesificaminwembili;
abakoBezayi babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili lane,
abakoHarifi babelikhulu letshumi lambili;
abakoGibeyoni babengamatshumi aficamunwemunye lanhlanu;
abaseBetlehema labaseNetofa babelikhulu lamatshumi aficaminwembili lesificaminwembili;
amadoda aseAnathothi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lesificaminwembili;
abaseAzimavethi babengamatshumi amane lambili;
abaseKiriyathi‐Jeyarimi labaseKefira labaseBerothi babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amane lantathu;
abaseRama labaseGeba babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lanye;
amadoda aseMikimasi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lambili;
amadoda aseBetheli laseAyi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
abaseNebo babengamatshumi amahlanu lambili;
abaseElamu elinye babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane;
abaseHarimi babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili;
abaseJeriko babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
abaseLodi labaseHadidi labaseOno babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili lanye;
abaseSenaha babezinkulungwane ezintathu lamakhulu aficamunwemunye lamatshumi amathathu.
Nantu uluhlu lwabapristi. AbakoJedaya, abendlu kaJeshuwa, babengamakhulu aficamunwemunye lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lantathu;
abakoImeri babeyinkulungwane lamatshumi amahlanu lambili;
abakoPashuri babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amane lesikhombisa;
abakoHarimi babeyinkulungwane letshumi lesikhombisa.
Nantu uluhlu lwamaLevi. AbakoJeshuwa ngitsho abakoKadimiyeli, usendo lukaHodaviya, babengamatshumi ayisikhombisa lane.
Nantu uluhlu lwabahlabeleli. AbakoAsafi babelikhulu lamatshumi amane lesificaminwembili.
Nantu uluhlu lwabalindi bamasango. AbakoShaluma labakoAteri labakoTalimoni labakoAkubi labakoHatita labakoShobayi, bonke babelikhulu lamatshumi amathathu lesificaminwembili.
Nantu uluhlu lwezinceku zasethempelini. AbakoZiha labakoHasufa labakoTabhawothi
labakoKerosi labakoSiya labakoPadoni
labakoLebana labakoHagaba labakoShalimayi
labakoHanani labakoGideli labakoGahari
labakoReyaya labakoRezini labakoNekoda
labakoGazama labakoUza labakoPaseya
labakoBesayi labakoMewunimi labakoNefushesimi
labakoBakibuki labakoHakufa labakoHarihuri
labakoBazilithi labakoMehida labakoHarisha
labakoBarkosi labakoSisera labakoTema
labakoNeziya labakoHatifa.
Nantu uluhlu lwenzalo yenzinceku zikaSolomoni. AbakoSotayi labakoSoferethi labakoPerida
labakoJahala labakoDarkoni labakoGideli
labakoShefathiya labakoHathili labakoPokerethi‐Hazebayimi labakoAmoni.
Zonke inceku zasethempelini lenzalo yezinceku zikaSolomoni babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi aficamunwemunye lambili.
Nampa abavela eTeli‐Mela laseTeli‐Harisha laseKerubi laseAdoni laseImeri ababengelakutsho izindlu zaboyise, lokuba badabuka koIsrayeli yini,
abakoDelaya labakoTobiya labakoNekoda, babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amane lambili.
Phakathi kwabapristi kwakungabakoHobaya labakoHakozi labakoBarizilayi, owayethethe enye yamadodakazi kaBarizilayi waseGileyadi, wasebizwa ngebizo lawo.
Badinga amabizo abo oluhlwini lwabalotshiweyo ngezizukulwana, kodwa bawaswela; basebekhutshwa ebupristini, kwathiwa kabafanelanga.
Umbusi wabatshela ukuba bangadli ukudla okungcwele, kuze kube khona umpristi wokubuza inkatho iUrimi leThumimi.
Dute 33:8
Lonke ibandla selihlangene lalingabantu abazinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lambili lamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi ayisithupha,

ngaphandle kwenceku lencekukazi zabo ezazizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa lamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amathathu lesikhombisa; babelabahlabeleli abesilisa labesifazana abangamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amane lanhlanu.
Amabhiza abo ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amathathu lesithupha, lembongolo zabo zingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
amakamela abo engamakhulu amane lamatshumi amathathu lanhlanu, labobabhemi babo bezinkulungwane eziyisithupha lamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili.

Ezinye inhloko zezindlu zanikela emsebenzini. Umbusi wanikela esikhwameni somsebenzi inhlamvu zegolide eziyinkulungwane, lemiganu yokuchela engamatshumi amahlanu, lezambatho zabapristi ezingamakhulu amahlanu lamatshumi amathathu.
Ezinye inhloko zezindlu zanikela esikhwameni somsebenzi inhlamvu zegolide ezizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili
esiliva azinkulungwane ezilikhulu letshumi.
Abanye abantu banikela inhlamvu zegolide ezizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili
esiliva azinkulungwane ezilikhulu lezambatho zabapristi ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lesikhombisa.
Abapristi lamaLevi labalindi bamasango labahlabeleli labanye abantu lezinceku zasethempelini kanye labo bonke abanye abakoIsrayeli bahlala emizini yabo.
